d: Is Yashasvi Jaiswal planning to leave Rajasthan Royals? The IPL rumour mill is buzzing with questions about Jaiswal's future with the franchise, while Riyan Parag and the team's leadership are also becoming talking points. In this episode of Zero Cricket Knowledge, we(Chayan Rastogi, Abhishek Manchanda) discuss the speculation surrounding Yashasvi Jaiswal and Rajasthan Royals, possible reasons behind the reported uncertainty, Riyan Parag's role and what this could mean for the franchise ahead of the next IPL season.
